EnumProperty.Name: OutpostFrontierEnableTickProfile
EnumProperty.Description: Shared by Common and the client, for every configuration. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: OutpostFrontierBetaLabel
EnumProperty.Description: draws the 'Beta 2' label in the top-left corner of every frame (OUTPOST_FRONTIER_BETA_LABEL, client only). After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: OutpostFrontierWidescreenSupport
EnumProperty.Description: display modes wider than 4:3 in the options, Hor+ cameras and HUD windows at the screen edges (OUTPOST_FRONTIER_WIDESCREEN_SUPPORT, client only). Off builds the baseline 4:3-only behaviour. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: OutpostFrontierDx9Renderer
EnumProperty.Description: builds DX9RENDERER.dll (the Direct3D 9 mirror of DX8RENDERER, needs the DirectX SDK June 2010) and the client's Direct3D 9 extension hooks such as the volumetric nebula (OUTPOST_FRONTIER_DX9RENDERER). Select it at run time with DirectX9 in bin\NEURONCOMPONENTS.INI. Off builds neither. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.

EnumProperty.Name: OutpostFrontierWalkMode
EnumProperty.Description: walking through base rooms as Rellan (OUTPOST_FRONTIER_WALK_MODE, client only; docs/walk_mode.md). Off builds the baseline base screens. After changing it, save this property sheet and rebuild the solution.
